verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Hoppscotch supports scripting for pre-request logic and test cases, and the CLI can run these tests (hopp test) with JUnit report generation, implying assertion-style testing exists. However, the evidence never explicitly describes assertion syntax against response status, body, or headers, so the breadth of the story is not directly confirmed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of assertion API/methods for status codes, response body content, and header values, and hands-on examples showing these tests being written.
